title: artset-list
description: The list of one user's picture sets for one book (sync/artsets/{user}/{book}.json), plus which set is active. Always includes the synthetic 'default' set. Syncs like annotations — server-authoritative merge (a later cycle adds tombstones). A set only changes how the book's illustrations look, never the page text/layout.

book_id.description: Permanent book identifier these sets illustrate.

user_id.description: Id of the household profile that owns these sets (matches users[].id).

active_set_id.description: Which set the reader currently displays. 'default' or a 'set-<hex>' id.

sets.description: Summaries of this user's sets for the book, including the synthetic 'default' entry.

render_progress.description: While status is 'generating', how many of the set's pictures have rendered so far. Absent once the set is 'ready' or 'failed', and absent offline (the reader falls back to plain 'making…' text).

total.description: Total pictures the set will render (page plates + cover + one portrait per major character).

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation timestamp. Absent for the synthetic default set.
